# Data Dictionary — VinhaGuard AI

**File:** `data/processed/vinhaguard_dataset.parquet` (also `.csv`)  
**Shape:** 960 rows × 21 columns (32 locations × 30 years, 1995–2024)  
**Generated by:** `src/data/make_dataset.py` → `src/data/build_features.py`  
**Positive-class share:** 39.8% (`climate_stress_year = 1`)

---

## Column reference

| name | dtype | units | description | source | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `location_id` | `object` | — | Hand-curated vineyard site identifier. Format `XX##` where prefix encodes the IVDP subregion: `BC` = Baixo Corgo (BC01–BC12), `CC` = Cima Corgo (CC01–CC14), `DS` = Douro Superior (DS01–DS10). | `data/locations.csv` | 32 of 36 planned sites have weather data; see `weather_data_available` in locations.csv. |
| `year` | `int64` | year | Calendar year of observation. Range: 1995–2024 (30 years). | Open-Meteo ERA5 | — |
| `subregion` | `object` | — | IVDP Douro Demarcated Region sub-region classification. One of: `"Baixo Corgo"`, `"Cima Corgo"`, `"Douro Superior"`. | IVDP classification, hand-curated | — |
| `elevation_m` | `int64` | m (a.s.l.) | Vineyard site elevation above sea level. | Hand-curated | Range 88–695 m across 32 sites. |
| `latitude` | `float64` | decimal degrees (WGS84) | Site latitude, north-positive. | Hand-curated | 4 decimal places. |
| `longitude` | `float64` | decimal degrees (WGS84) | Site longitude, west-negative (all sites in Portugal). | Hand-curated | 4 decimal places. |
| `heat_days_30` | `int64` | days | Number of days in the calendar year where daily maximum temperature (tmax) ≥ 30 °C. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Full-year window (Jan–Dec). |
| `heat_days_35` | `int64` | days | Number of days in the calendar year where tmax ≥ 35 °C. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Used as condition (a) in `climate_stress_year` label; threshold is the per-location 80th percentile. |
| `heat_days_38` | `int64` | days | Number of days in the calendar year where tmax ≥ 38 °C. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Aligns with the parametric trigger threshold used in the Streamlit demo (14 days ≥ 38 °C during véraison). |
| `max_summer_tmax` | `float64` | °C | Maximum daily maximum temperature over June–August (JJA). | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Core véraison heat indicator. NaN if no JJA data. |
| `mean_summer_tmax` | `float64` | °C | Mean of daily maximum temperatures over June–August (JJA). | Open-Meteo ERA5 | JJA window (months 6–8). |
| `heatwave_max_streak` | `int64` | days | Longest consecutive run of days with tmax ≥ 35 °C in the calendar year. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | 0 if no day reaches threshold. Full-year window. |
| `gdd_growing_season` | `float64` | °C·days | Growing Degree Days (base 10 °C) accumulated over April–October: Σ max(0, tmean − 10). Standard viticulture heat-accumulation metric. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Growing season window: months 4–10. |
| `spring_frost_days` | `int64` | days | Number of days in March–May where daily minimum temperature (tmin) < 0 °C. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Budbreak and flowering frost-risk window. |
| `spring_severe_frost_days` | `int64` | days | Number of days in March–May where tmin < −2 °C. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Threshold at which tissue damage to young vine shoots is likely. Used as condition (b) in `climate_stress_year`: ≥ 3 days → stress = 1. |
| `min_spring_tmin` | `float64` | °C | Minimum daily minimum temperature recorded in March–May. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Most extreme cold event in the frost-risk window. |
| `annual_precip_mm` | `float64` | mm | Total precipitation sum for the calendar year (Jan–Dec). | Open-Meteo ERA5 | — |
| `summer_precip_mm` | `float64` | mm | Total precipitation sum for June–August (JJA). | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Low summer rainfall is normal in the Douro; extreme drought amplifies heat stress during berry development. |
| `dry_days` | `int64` | days | Number of days in the calendar year with precipitation < 1 mm (meteorological dry-day threshold). | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Full-year window. |
| `max_consecutive_dry_days` | `int64` | days | Longest consecutive run of days with precipitation < 1 mm in the calendar year. | Open-Meteo ERA5 | Used as condition (c) in `climate_stress_year`; threshold is the per-location 80th percentile. Full-year window. |
| `climate_stress_year` | `int64` | binary (0 / 1) | **Target variable.** 1 = climate stress year, 0 = normal year. See labelling rule below. | Derived — `src/data/make_dataset.py` | 39.8% positive class overall. Rule is tunable in `label_stress_year()`. |

---

## Target variable — labelling rule

A year is labelled **`climate_stress_year = 1`** if **any** of the following conditions holds:

| Condition | Variable | Threshold | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| (a) Anomalous heat | `heat_days_35` | ≥ 80th percentile of that **location's own** 30-year distribution | — |
| (b) Spring frost event | `spring_severe_frost_days` | ≥ 3 days (absolute) | Three or more days below −2 °C during flowering is a commercially significant damage threshold. |
| (c) Anomalous drought | `max_consecutive_dry_days` | ≥ 80th percentile of that **location's own** 30-year distribution | — |

### Why per-location percentiles, not global ones

Douro Superior vineyards regularly record 8–12 °C higher summer temperatures than Baixo Corgo. A globally-computed 80th-percentile heat threshold would be dominated by the hottest sub-region, causing nearly all Baixo Corgo years to be labelled "normal" and nearly all Douro Superior years to be labelled "stressed" — irrespective of whether a year was anomalous *for that site*. Per-location percentiles ensure the model learns **relative climate anomalies** (how unusual this year was for this vineyard) rather than absolute climate, which is the ecologically meaningful signal for parametric insurance trigger calibration.

### Known-year validation

The labelling rule was validated against independently documented extreme years for the Iberian Peninsula:

| Year | % locations stressed | Known event |
|---|---|---|
| 1999 | 3% | Mild, wet Atlantic year |
| 2003 | **81%** | European heatwave (hottest summer in 500 years) |
| 2005 | **94%** | Severe Iberian drought |
| 2017 | **94%** | Record heat + wildfires across Portugal |
| 2022 | **100%** | Exceptional pan-Iberian heat and drought |
| 2024 | **94%** | Near-record heat across the Douro |

## Excluded columns (present in `data/locations.csv` only)

| name | reason for exclusion |
|---|---|
| `name` | Free-text site label; not a model feature |
| `weather_data_available` | Pipeline flag; not a model feature. 4 locations (CC03, CC12, DS05, DS10) are `False` and are excluded from this dataset. |
